entities.name: Gaius Acilius
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gaius Acilius was a senator and historian of ancient Rome. He knew Greek, and in 155 BC interpreted for Carneades, Diogenes, and Critolaus, who had come to the Roman Senate on an embassy from Athens.
